goal: Identify the limiting resource and service-visible opportunity before selecting an optimization target

ceiling_levels.architectural_peak: conditional physical upper rate with exact SKU/clock/ISA/dtype/counting convention; no hardcoded device rates
ceiling_levels.sustained_microbenchmark: same-device calibrated achievable reference with matching size/cache/access pattern; not a physical upper bound
ceiling_levels.matched_reference: same operator/shape/layout/routing/topology implementation reference; may be exceeded

gather_scatter.probe: captured index locality, alignment and access-size sweep

point_to_point.probe: same peer placement and message-size curve

capture_passes.purpose: precision before -> complete unprofiled fixed-work service/forward/operator samples -> precision after
representative service-linked prefill CPU/GPU/stream/collective capture on all ranks
targeted same-signature resource counters, raw report plus searchable export and missing-field inventory
same owned device and controlled clock/cache/shape/topology reference probes, precision before and after
one-variable perturbation and paired whole-forward/service A/B to test the bottleneck hypothesis

nvidia-sm90.counters: Nsight Compute; query exact supported metrics for installed version

nvidia-sm103.counters: Nsight Compute; independently verify feature and counter support

moore-s5000.timeline: verified MUSA tracing/export on installed runtime
moore-s5000.counters: MCU export with exact tool version and copy/counter calibration

required_counter_semantics: counter traffic versus analytical minimum bytes
wire versus payload versus collective bus bandwidth
raw unavailable values are unknown, never zero

attribution.work_share: sum GPU durations by group / all included GPU duration sum
attribution.wall_coverage: per-group time union / captured forward window
attribution.exclusive_exposure: group active with no other GPU group active; not a causal critical path
attribution.overlap: per-rank/device compute/communication intersection plus distinct-stream activity union
attribution.invocation_count: requires explicit correlation; GPU event count is not framework invocation count

bottleneck_flow: validate comparable service cohort and cache
separate service queue/CPU/transfer from native forward
inspect all-rank exposed time and slow-rank hypotheses
model resource times without summing overlapped components
separate measurement gaps, kernel-efficiency gaps and work/traffic reduction
verify dependencies and one-variable causal response
paired unprofiled service/forward requalification and next trace
limitations: Resource-model thresholds route investigation; they do not confirm a bottleneck
Step resource ceilings are conditional optimistic bounds, not attainable service throughput
Automatic cross-host clock synchronization, dependency DAG, profiler parsing and counter collection are not implemented
